portages.name: pig-portage
portages.note: Pig portage — bridges the data gap between Threenarrows Lake and Baie Fine. Threenarrows trailhead (46.063, -81.470) is inside the CanVec Threenarrows polygon; Baie Fine trailhead (46.025, -81.498) is inside the LAKE_SUPPLEMENT Baie Fine polygon. Real portage is famously rough ~5km; straight-line approximation is good enough for routing connectivity.

_meta.purpose: Synthetic portages added manually to bridge gaps in killarneyPortages.gpx. Each entry is a straight line between two real-world portage trailheads.
